name: PassMark: Memory Read Uncached
description: Read a combination of 32-bit and 64-bit data from memory using a 512 MB block size.
note: This benchmark score is largely independent of vCPU count within an instance family and mainly reflects hardware generation and memory characteristics, not instance size.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
